stemMd: A lively travel diary says, "At dawn we squeezed onto the ferry, clutching paper cups of coffee." Which continuation is most consistent?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Departure constitutes a standard stage of maritime transit.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Marine transportation commenced at the designated hour.

options.label: C
options.textMd: It is hereby certified that the vessel departed.

options.label: D
options.textMd: The deck shivered beneath our feet as the engine rumbled awake.

explanationMd: The diary brings the reader into an immediate experience. The moving deck and rumbling engine continue that concrete, sensory description.

distractorRationale.b: Administrative abstraction conflicts with the vivid personal narration.
distractorRationale.c: Certification language does not match a travel diary.
distractorRationale.a: An impersonal definition interrupts the sensory narrative.
